ASUS Prime GeForce RTX 5070 OC Edition 12GB GDDR7 Graphics Card

Unleash next-generation gaming performance and AI-accelerated workflows with the ASUS Prime GeForce RTX 5070 OC Edition 12GB GDDR7 graphics card, distributed via Turbo Computer Egypt. Built on NVIDIA's high-efficiency next-gen architecture, this advanced GPU features 12GB of ultra-fast dedicated GDDR7 memory to deliver exceptionally smooth high-frame-rate gaming at demanding resolutions. The sophisticated 2.5-slot compact profile is engineered to ensure seamless compatibility with small form factor (SFF) desktop setups while keeping thermal management at its peak. Equipped with a premium triple-fan array operating on dual ball bearings, it guarantees exceptional, quiet cooling under extended heavy loads. Factory overclocked for enhanced performance out of the box, this cutting-edge graphics infrastructure is backed by a 3-year official warranty.
